gloss: running speed; travel speed (of a vehicle)

definitions.gloss: running speed; travel speed; driving speed
definitions.explanation: The speed at which a vehicle is traveling. Used for cars, trains, bicycles, and other vehicles in both everyday and technical contexts.

examples.japanese: {走行速度|そうこうそくど}を{落|お}としてください。
この{区間|くかん}の{平均|へいきん}{走行速度|そうこうそくど}は{時速|じそく}60キロだ。
examples.english: The average travel speed for this section is 60 km/h.

examples.japanese: {雨|あめ}の{日|ひ}は{走行速度|そうこうそくど}を{控|ひか}えめにして、{車間距離|しゃかんきょり}を{十分|じゅうぶん}に{取|と}りましょう。
examples.english: On rainy days, keep your driving speed moderate and maintain plenty of distance between vehicles.

notes:
Composed of {走行|そうこう} (running, traveling by vehicle) + {速度|そくど} (speed, velocity). A standard term in driving, traffic engineering, and transportation contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {平均|へいきん}{走行速度|そうこうそくど}: average travel speed
- {最高|さいこう}{走行速度|そうこうそくど}: maximum travel speed
- {走行速度|そうこうそくど}を{上|あ}げる: to increase speed
- {走行速度|そうこうそくど}を{落|お}とす: to reduce speed
- {走行速度|そうこうそくど}{制限|せいげん}: speed limit (while driving)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {速度|そくど}: speed — more general, applies to anything
- スピード: speed — English loanword, casual
- {時速|じそく}: speed per hour (km/h or mph)
- {制限速度|せいげんそくど}: speed limit — the legal limit
